messages:
tess (pm): quick follow-up on the onprem RFC: we still need a tight eviction/invalidate contract for rollback so serving nodes don't serve partially-applied shards. can we define minimal token + ack semantics?

ian (eng-arch): propose signed invalidate token with fields (manifest, shard_seq, action, ts, nonce). serving node must verify signature and seq > last_seen_seq before evicting. publish ack back to controller with node_id + seq.

rohit (eng-infra): operational notes: tokens should be HMAC-SHA256 with per-customer key stored in KMS. controllers emit token and index it in the ledger entry so auditors can correlate actions. also, temp-write files use `.tmp.<seq>` and GC removes stale temps after 24h.

anya (security): add replay protection: short TTL (60s) and nonce cache on nodes. ledger must record sig_key_id and sig_type (kms|local). local signatures allowed only if attested; console must flag them amber. archive ledger blobs to immutable storage for compliance window.

morgan (operator): UX asks: console should preview the invalidate blast radius before confirm and CLI should support `--dry-run`. example: `redwoodctl activation rollback --manifest m-... --shard s12 --dry-run` returns a list of prefixes and would-be token.

ian (eng-arch): agree. add an idempotency key to tokens so replay after leader-confirm is a no-op. controllers should retry emits until ack or until configured timeout then escalate.

tess (pm): action items: 1) add token format + ack flow to RFC (ian), 2) GC and temp-file rules (rohit), 3) ledger audit + archive rules (anya), 4) console dry-run & preview mockups (morgan). i'll draft follow-up and PR.

deploy-bot: queued rfc/onprem-evict-contract patch -> staging (id: d-7093)

ian (eng-arch): thanks, short and actionable.
